sections: Crop PDF pages online, automatically or precisely

Crop PDF trims the edges of PDF pages. Use **Auto crop** to remove white margins around the content automatically, with a little padding so nothing feels cramped, or switch to **Manual** to cut an exact number of millimetres from the top, right, bottom and left. You can crop every page or only a range such as 2-10, and the result is a new PDF – your original file is not changed.

Cropping is ideal for reading PDFs on a phone or e-reader (wide margins waste screen space), preparing figures and diagrams for slides, removing scanner borders and black edges, cutting printer's marks from print-ready files, and tidying screenshots that were saved as PDF.

Auto crop renders each page on your device, finds the outermost non-white pixels, and sets the crop box just outside them plus the padding you choose (3 mm by default). With **Same crop box on every page** ticked, the tool uses the smallest margin found across all selected pages, so every page keeps the same size and content never jumps around when you flip pages – best for books and reports. Untick it to crop each page tightly to its own content, which suits figure collections and scanned receipts of different sizes.
Pages that are rotated in the file are left as they are in auto mode, and completely blank pages are skipped.

sections: PDF cropping works by changing the page's visible area – the crop box, media box, trim box and bleed box are all set to the new size, so every viewer and printer shows the cropped page. The content outside the box is hidden, not erased, which keeps quality perfect and the operation lossless. If you need hidden content to be truly gone (for example, confidential notes in a margin), use [Redact PDF](/redact-pdf/) or [Flatten PDF](/flatten-pdf/) in *all content* mode afterwards.

To get a cropped picture rather than a PDF – a figure for a presentation or a website – crop here first, then convert the result with [PDF to JPG](/pdf-to-jpg/) or [PDF to PNG](/pdf-to-png/). Because the crop box is respected, the images contain only the area you kept.

Cropping removes edges and makes the page smaller. [Resize PDF](/resize-pdf/) changes the paper size – for example, from Letter to A4 – by scaling the content to fit. If a document must be a specific paper size after cropping, crop first and then resize.

list: For books, keep *same crop box* on so pages line up; for mixed documents, turn it off.

Scanned pages with grey backgrounds or dark borders may not count as ‘white’; use manual crop or clean the scan first.
Crop only the pages that need it by entering a range – covers often have different margins.
Check the first and last page after cropping: page numbers in the footer are content too and will be kept.

sections: Crop PDF online vs desktop software

Desktop editors can crop pages, but usually require a paid licence. Most online croppers upload your file to a server. This tool gives you auto and manual cropping for free, entirely in your browser – useful for contracts, drawings and other files you would rather not upload.
